 |description = {{Description|decoration}} }} :''See also: [[Fancy House Plant]]'' The '''House Plant''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]]. Depending on the farm map selected by the player, different House Plants will appear inside of their starter house or cabin: *Houses and cabins on the [[Farm Maps|Standard Farm]] will have House Plant 1 when the game begins. *Houses and cabins on the [[Farm Maps|Wilderness Farm]] will have House Plant 8 when the game begins. *Houses and cabins on the [[Farm Maps|Four Corners Farm]] will have House Plants 2, 6, and 10 when the game begins. *Houses and cabins on the [[Farm Maps|Meadowlands Farm]] will have House Plants 12 and 15 when the game begins. Any of the 15 varieties of the House Plant can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|250}} or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}. Each of the 15 varieties of the House Plant are available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}. House Plant 7 can be purchased from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]] for {{Price|700}}. House Plant 13 can be won in the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]]. It can appear randomly, during any season. The description of House Plant 13 won at the Crane Game reads "Adds some character to your home or farm.". When right-clicking on this plant, its appearance changes between several varieties of House Plant. There is a small chance to receive a House Plant from slaying [[monsters]], breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]], chopping [[trees]], shaking trees with seeds, digging [[Artifact Spot]]s, or [[Pans|panning]].
